responsibility: Defines the ISO SYSTEM module interface for gm2, exposing implementation properties of storage and addresses, compiler-provided low-level types and builtins, and the runtime helpers used for set bit operations that cannot always be inlined. In addition to the language-standard declarations for ADDRESS arithmetic, casts, shifts, rotates, and size queries, it declares the multiword Shift* and Rotate* procedures and the THROW/TBITSIZE builtins that generated code and low-level runtime support rely on.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the declaration side of the SYSTEM pair: it exposes the ISO SYSTEM types, constants, builtins, and runtime entry points that generated code may call, while SYSTEM.mod implements only the runtime procedures for multiword shift and rotate support.
